card.disclaimer: Trained on DETERMINISTIC SIMULATED data to demonstrate and prove the AI pipeline architecture. NOT scientifically validated; not trained on verified real government event/non-event censuses. Metrics are held-out on simulated data and describe pipeline generalization only.

historical_data_inspection.reason: Verified catalogs are CATALOG-ONLY reference inventories. They record positive event occurrences but lack nationwide confirmed non-event observation coverage. Unobserved locations must not be falsely converted into negative training samples (-1 != 0). Real operational model validation is deferred until exhaustive observational censuses are integrated.

threshold_objective: F-beta (beta=2.0) with min_specificity>=0.25 on validation set
threshold_type: ML decision threshold (not official government threshold)
